title: The local weak limit of uniform random fullerenes
scope: For every r and every rooted simple graph (K,o), along the n admitting a fullerene, the probability that the ball of radius r around a uniform root of a uniform isomorphism class of fullerene graphs on n vertices is rooted-isomorphic to the ball of (K,o) tends to 1 or 0 according as the corresponding ball of the hexagonal lattice of Eq. (3) is isomorphic to it; and the limit filter is proper. A fullerene is a finite connected cubic simple graph admitting a genus-0 rotation system with every face of length 5 or 6; balls use the strict inequality of the source.
source_targets: Bille, Buchstaber, Coste, Kuriki, Spodarev, arXiv 2306.01462v2, Definition 2, Eq. (3), Eq. (4), Conjecture 1
validation: Fifty modules compiled and kernel-checked from an empty build by an independent reviewer. A transitive closure of 27,127 constants has only the three permitted axioms and no unsafe or partial constant. Statement fidelity PASS against the source and the literal. Lean controls prove the dodecahedron a fullerene from the definition, reject toroidal K4 and the hexagonal prism, and pin the strict ball convention by lattice balls of 1, 4 and 10 vertices; a false adjacency and a sorry were rejected. The reviewer read 17 statement and bridge modules in full and the other 33 at declaration level, relying on the kernel for their proof scripts. Root verified receipts, hashes and the mathlib pin, read the statement and the fidelity record, and read and partly hand-checked the paper.
substantive_reason: Proves in full a deliberate conjecture whose authors name their obstacle, the missing bound on A(k,l,p), and say they could not extract it from Thurston. The proof bypasses that obstacle by a count of short-tube fullerenes independent of n, from an exact ring identity in the dual triangulation that makes tubes rigid, together with an elementary construction giving F(n) to infinity. The identity is specific to the structure and is not an index change of the source. Nothing read gives the result by a complete bridge. Two adversarial reviews recommended credit.
contrary_scope_assessment: Significance is recorded as modest and both reviewers, and the auditor, said an exclusion on significance would be defensible. The result is the expected picture; tube rarity corresponds to cusp volume in Thurston and a specialist route of perhaps a few pages may exist, though one key step is unprinted in what was read and Thurston was unread. The core lemmas use only degrees at most 6. The rigid-tube picture is close to folklore in the cap and nanotube literature, though no printed uniform statement was found. Root accepted because no complete reduction exists, the identified obstacle is genuinely removed, and the result was carried through a literal 13,000-line Lean proof. The user may overrule.
novelty_standard: Qualified bounded source-primary investigation, not worldwide priority certification.
prior_limits: No citation index. The journal version J. Phys. A 58(2) (2025) 025212 is unread, so whether it keeps Conjecture 1 is unknown; if the journal version or a later paper settles the conjecture, the acceptance must be revisited. Thurston, Brinkmann and coauthors, Graver, Kardos-Skrekovski and Angel-Benjamini-Horesh are unread; the Kardos habilitation and MATCH 71(1) 99-114 are closed. Registry roots closed.
process_adjudication: Disclosed and judged non-substantive: displays over the 15000-character cap in several lanes; wrapper stdout sent to /dev/null with true exits in receipts; failed receipts kept; the Lean author reported 75 of 109 compile runs failed and one memory kill, whereas the receipts show 59 failed of 119 Lean runs and none marked killed, and the receipt count is the one of record. Certificate content rests on the fresh replay and the kernel rather than on those histories.
trust_limits: Upstream Lean, mathlib and their oleans are trusted through pins and were not rebuilt. Reviewers are AI systems, not human referees, and the reviewers, auditor and Lean author share a model family. The auditor did not read 33 proof scripts line by line. Planarity is rendered as a genus-0 rotation system; its equivalence with topological planarity is classical and not proved in Lean. The labelled reading of uniform is not formalized. Whitney uniqueness is neither proved nor used: each class is handled through one chosen embedding.
paper_corrections: Root corrected the description of loops and parallel edges in the proof of Proposition 3.1, repaired a Lean quotation, completed one sentence, reworded attributions and fixed page layout; see qa/ROOT-CORRECTIONS.json. The proof structure was not changed.
not_claimed: Any rate beyond the stated bound
